fieldValues.title: A dispatch-suggested manifest token list can cite a schema that was already retired
fieldValues.summary: Issue #633's own dispatch text listed schema:relations-collection.json as an expected manifest token for RFC-038, but that file was deleted three weeks earlier by srs#527 (retiring the dead relations-collection shape once RFC-038's own one-file-per-relation model superseded it). Verifying the suggested token list against the current docs/schema/2.0/ directory -- rather than the tracking issue's prose -- caught this before it produced an unresolvable token and a red check-rfc-integration.mjs run.
evidence: docs/schema/2.0/relations-collection.json does not exist in the current tree
commit a96ac29 'fix(spec): retire relations-collection.json (srs#527)' deleted it and repointed RFC-017/RFC-023's manifests off it
issue #633's body still names schema:relations-collection.json among the tokens RFC-038's manifest should declare
fieldValues.body: A tracking issue's suggested token/artifact list is a plan, not a spec -- it is written once and the corpus keeps moving. Any unit that executes an older issue's suggested manifest must re-derive the token list against the current repository state (git history + current schema directory), not copy the issue text verbatim.
